fields.Name: T2p -> S-T.6
fields.Description: Gate G2.14 (phase 2, dataset T2p, criterion S-T.6): residual autocorrelation is flagged on T2p, 1 of 1, by Box–Pierce on the selected model's residuals pooled within entities, the reference pipeline's panel statistic (reference acf1 0.723, p 0.0000), and Ljung–Box does not flag T1p's final-origin residuals (reference p 0.9002). It fails when the residual check skips the test on pooled panel residuals (T2p not flagged).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: T2p's pooled within-entity residual autocorrelation (Box-Pierce on 3 lags) is flagged and T1p's final-origin residuals (Ljung-Box) are not (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
